svg.title: Cortical syndromes: test comprehension first, then fluency and repetition; the pattern names the aphasia and localizes it in the dominant hemisphere (Broca's inferior frontal, Wernicke's posterior temporal, global full MCA territory; conduction and the transcortical aphasias for keeners); neglect points to the non-dominant hemisphere, and apraxia, cortical sensory signs and extinction also localize to the cortex
